-- Step 2: Set parentId from CONTAINS relationships where parentId is null
UPDATE asset_instances ai

FROM \(
  SELECT DISTINCT ON \(ar.target_asset_id\) ar.target_asset_id as target_id, ar.source_asset_id as source_id
  FROM asset_relationships ar

\) sub
WHERE ai.id = sub.target_id
AND ai.parent_id IS NULL;
")
